Developed by Experts to Save Lives
The Carecube was initially funded by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) and further supported by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR). It was developed in collaboration with frontline nurses, doctors, and emergency responders in a diverse set of hospitals and care settings across the United States, and in partnership with the University of Nebraska Medical Center, a worldwide leader in infectious disease response.
